name: observation_log_villainess
about: Observation Log story Short: Cecil, a ten-year-old genius prince who understands everything on first hearing, meets his fiancee Bertia - who announces she is the Villainess and will tear him from the heroine, doomed to fall 'beautifully, a first-rate flower of evil'. At last, something he doesn't understand. The drop runs their story; ends on him: the world had lost its color - but this is different.
anime: An Observation Log of My Fiancee Who Calls Herself a Villainess

story.why: today I'm meeting my fiancee... I'm not sure I understand what she's talking about
I am the Villainess, Prince Cecil. It is my duty to tear you and the heroine apart!
though I'm doomed to fall, I'll do so beautifully! A first-rate flower of evil!
at last, something I don't understand

outro.why: I rarely feel accomplishment. The world has lost its color. But this is different.

title: Genius Prince Finally Meets Someone He Can't Understand: His Villainess Fiancee
hook: Prince Cecil understands everything the first time he hears it. Then his fiancee declares she is the villainess destined to ruin him - beautifully.
